title: Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Detect synaptic links and assign both partners in the original BANC EM evaluation cutouts; either incorrect partner is a source evaluation error.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Detect synaptic links and assign both partners in the original BANC EM evaluation cutouts; either incorrect partner is a source evaluation error.

Source-paper comparison for Aggregate synaptic-link F1 on original 16 expert-annotated cutouts (ED Fig. 2b): Aggregate F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), with either partner incorrect counted as an error. Exact prediction-to-expert matching and ambiguity-adjudication rules must be frozen; precision/recall remain required diagnostics.
success_criteria: Recover exact original 16 cutouts, annotations, partner identities, training/evaluation separation and matching rules.
Use identical source inputs and original task; a new set of regions, edited gold labels or easier partner-detection target is not a paper win.
Compare aggregate counts with a verified author baseline and the reported 0.83 F-score, retaining precision/recall and all per-cutout results.
Freeze candidate thresholds and all postprocessing before final evaluation; predeclare effect, uncertainty and equal access/resource budgets.
Graph reconstruction/runtime and separate neurotransmitter-classification scores cannot replace this detection endpoint.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.

episode.improvement_loop: After original split recovery, expose only source-authorized training/development imagery and feedback; keep the original evaluation annotations protected.

episode.baseline_policy: Published F-score, exact source counts and reproduced author detector are distinct. Synapses_v3 is not silently substituted for the original v2 result; neurotransmitter prediction remains a separate source task.
